[[Bryan]] fled with his family to [[Cantha]] to escape the [[Charr]] invasion in [[Ascalon]]. His family succumbed to the plague and now he is alone wishing to return to Ascalon.

==Dialogue==
When spoken to in Bukdek Byway:
:''"My life is one disaster after another; first the Charr in Ascalon, then the plague here in Cantha."''

When spoken to in Ascalon City:
:''"Everyone gets gifts for Wintersday.  It's tradition. This year, I'm hoping for something extra special..."''

==Quotes==
Idle quotes in Ascalon City:
:''"Everyone gets gifts for Wintersday.  It's tradition. This year, I'm hoping for something extra special..."''

==Notes==
*When approaching him to accept or hand in the quest [[Going Home]], be warned that if [[Chasing Zenmai]] is active a number of level 20 [[Am Fah]] will drop in to join you! Bryan will immediately begin fighting them, and will likely die due to his low level. If you try to get the reward from him while he's fighting, he will refuse to talk to you. Consider bringing a [[Protection Prayers]] [[monk]] with effective, fast-casting spells, such as [[Protective Spirit]], [[Shield Guardian]], and, if possible, [[Shield of Deflection]].  Alternatively, finish Chasing Zenmai and return later.
*During every [[Wintersday]], a Bryan appears in Ascalon City having the Ascalon Farmer [[skin]].
